evidence.reason: Line 177 substitutes both `%i` and `%I` with the raw instance text. systemd defines `%I` as the unescaped instance name, so an instance such as `crq\x2dtick` must expand `%I.service` to `crq-tick.service`; the code instead produces `crq\x2dtick.service`, which can fail to match the target unit and drop the dependency edge. The fix is to unescape only the `%I` substitution while leaving `%i` unchanged.
